entries.english: Feudal affairs and vassal services of the von Rosenberg lords. Dates: 1569–1603, 1612, 1630–1631. Includes demands to attend feudal courts and render service; requests for enfeoffment with Hohenlohe fiefs after deaths; Zaisolph von Rosenberg's 1569 request to Count Eberhard von Hohenlohe-Waldenburg; Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg's 1630–1631 request after Georg Siegmund von Rosenberg's death; and requests after the death of Konrad von Rosenberg der Ältere (1582). Extent: 1 volume.
